description.value: Bomber Brewing is an East Vancouver craft brewery whose taproom sits directly on the Adanac cycling corridor, one of Vancouver's most-used bike routes. The taproom pours an extensive rotating lineup of house-brewed Czech-style lagers, ales, IPAs, and stouts, always including two Czech-style side-pull draft taps. Package sales and third-party beer delivery complement the sit-down taproom experience.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms an active brewery taproom at 1488 Adanac Street, East Vancouver, with phone 604-428-7457 matching OSM. The Adanac Amber Lager copy references 'the famous bike route' at the brewery address, confirming proximity to Vancouver's Adanac cycling corridor, but no explicit bike rack or parking is mentioned anywhere on the website. Takeout is positively confirmed via 'Pick up and delivery now available' and references to Uber Eats, DoorDash, and in-taproom package sales.
concerns: OSM address field contains only 'Vancouver' with no street address; website confirms full address as 1488 Adanac Street, Vancouver, BC — top-level address updated to website value.
OSM name is 'Bomber Tasting Room' while the website brand is 'Bomber Brewing'; the /pages/taproom subpage confirms the taproom operates at this address under the Bomber Brewing umbrella.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active craft brewery taproom on the Adanac cycling corridor with package sales and pickup — a natural and appealing stop for touring cyclists on that route.
